demos.title: A secure customer-support agent (ADK + MCP + A2A)
demos.summary: Every message passes a sanitizer, a security judge and a guardrail; every reply is masked; every tool call is checked in code. Run the slides' requests through each layer, with and without the checks.
optional: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (runs in mock mode without it)

demos.title: Tracing, a golden set, a release gate and a nightly judge
demos.summary: The Week 4 support agent with the after-launch layer: a trace of every request with its time and cost, a golden dataset that gates every release in CI, and a nightly judge that catches drift as a falling score.
needs: the c4-secure-support-agent folder (clone the whole repository)
optional: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (runs in mock mode without it)
